numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You are {@condition deafened} by the voices for 1 minute.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你因這些聲音而{@condition deafened||耳聾}一分鐘。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: In addition, when you cast {@spell dispel magic} using your Iconoclast Hero trait, you cast it as a 4th-level spell.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 此外，當你以反逆英雄特質施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}時，你可以以四環施展。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: In addition, when you cast {@spell dispel magic} using your Iconoclast Hero trait, you cast it as a 5th-level spell.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 此外，當你以反逆英雄特質施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}時，你可以以五環施展。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: When you finish a long rest, the world around you in a 10-mile radius becomes a siphon that will eventually leech away your vitality. You can remain in the area safely for a number of weeks equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 week). Thereafter, each time you finish a long rest in the area, you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} that can't be removed while you remain in the area.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你完成一次長休，你附近半徑10英里內的世界將會如同虹吸管一般，最終會吸乾你的生命力。你可以安全地在一片區域停留與你體質調整值相同數值的週數（最少一週）。之後，每次你在那片區域完成一次長休時，你必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定，否則獲得1級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，當你在那片區域內時不可被移除。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you wrap yourself in a starry cloak, appearing like a silhouette formed of the night sky. When you do, attack rolls have disadvantage against you. This cloak lasts for 1 minute, until you doff it (no action required), or until you die. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 以一個動作，你能以星光的遮蔽掩藏身形，讓自己看起彷彿一塊夜空的剪影。當你如此做時，對你進行的攻擊檢定具有劣勢。直到你解除它（不需要動作）或死亡之前，廕庇會存在一分鐘。一旦你使用該特性，直到結束一次長休以前你無法再次使用。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You can temporarily disperse or hide the watchers with some effort. With 1 minute of work and a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Animal Handling}) check, you can suppress your Borrowed Eyes and Dread Presence for 1 hour. Once you successfully suppress these features, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你可以透過一些努力暫時驅散或隱藏注視者。透過一分鐘的行動和一次成功的{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}）檢定，你可以抑制借目和恐怖存在1小時。一旦成功地抑制了這些特性，在你完成一個長休之前你都不能再這樣做了。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Each character that gains the curse is hunted by a {@creature wraith} that appears at sunset and vanishes at dawn, pursuing the single-minded goal of slaying the cursed individual. The wraith manifests in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of its victim. Destroying the wraith grants a temporary reprieve; it doesn't reform for 10 days. You can scale this curse for lower- and higher-level characters by choosing another kind of creature.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 每名受此詛咒的角色都會被一個日落出現黎明消失的{@creature wraith||邪靈}追獵，邪靈只有一個目標，那就是殺死受詛者。邪靈會在受詛者30尺內的一個未被佔據的區域內顯現。摧毀邪靈會獲得一個短暫的喘息時間，它不會在十天內再次顯形。你可以根據角色的等級調整選擇別的追獵生物來調整這個詛咒。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 10 times your level when you gain this blessing and when you gain a level.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你獲得該祝福或獲得新的等級時，你獲得等於你等級十倍的{@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB|臨時生命值}。此臨時生命值持續時間為整場冒險。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You gain one 9th-level spell slot, provided that you already have one.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你獲得一個9環法術位，前提是你已經擁有一個9環法術位。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you damages you, you can use your reaction to deal an amount of force damage to that creature equal to half the damage you took. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你可見的在你60尺內的一個生物對你造成傷害時，你可以用你的反應對該生物造成等同於你所受傷害一半的力場傷害。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: One Melee weapon you are holding is infused with supernatural might for 1 minute or until you aren't holding the weapon. Once per turn, when you hit a Dragon with this weapon, the Dragon takes an extra {@dice 3d6} damage of the weapon's type.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你持握的一把近戰武器會在一分鐘內或直到你不再持握該武器時被灌注超自然力量。每回合一次，當你以此武器命中龍類時，該龍類會受到額外{@dice 3d6}點該武器型別的傷害。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you can unleash a petrifying wave of magic from your eyes in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition petrified} condition for 1 hour. On a successful save, a creature is partially turned to stone and has the {@condition restrained} condition. A {@condition restrained} creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你可以從你的雙眼中在一處30尺錐狀空間內釋放一道石化的魔法波。每個處於該區域內的生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗則生物進入{@condition petrified||石化}狀態一小時。豁免成功則部分石化並進入{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態。一個{@condition restrained||束縛}的生物可在其的每回合結束時重複進行豁免，成功則結束自身的該效應。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: While you have this charm, you attract flies. As an action, you activate this charm to summon a {@creature horned devil}. This devil appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you, obeys your commands begrudgingly, and serves you under protest for 9 days or until it dies, whereupon it disappears. When the devil disappears, this charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你擁有這種護咒時，你會吸引蒼蠅。作為一個動作，你啟用這個護咒並召喚一個{@creature horned devil||角魔}。這個魔鬼出現在一個距你 30 英尺內的未被佔據的空間，不情願地服從你的命令，在抗議中服侍你九天，或者直到它死去，然後魔鬼消失。當魔鬼消失的時候，這個護咒就會從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: A fiery halo appears above your head when you receive this charm. This charm allows you to cast the {@spell hellish rebuke} spell (9th-level version) as a reaction. Once used nine times, the charm vanishes from you, as does the fiery halo.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你獲得這個護咒時，在你的頭上出現了一個火焰光環。這個護咒允許你用一個反應施放{@spell hellish rebuke||煉獄叱喝}（九環版本）。一旦使用了九次，護咒就會從你身上消失，火焰光環也一樣。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: While you have this charm, you attract flies. As an action, you activate this charm to summon a {@creature barbed devil}, two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils}, or three {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils}. All devils appear at once in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of you. Each devil obeys your commands and serves you eagerly for 9 days or until it dies, whereupon the devil disappears. Once all devils summoned by this charm disappear, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你擁有這種護咒時，你會吸引蒼蠅。作為一個動作，你啟用這個護咒並召喚一個{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}或兩個{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}或三個{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}。所有的魔鬼會同時出現在一個距你 30 英尺內的未被佔據的空間。每一個魔鬼都聽從你的命令，熱切地服侍你九天，或者直到其死亡，然後魔鬼就消失了。一旦所有被這個護咒召喚的魔鬼消失，護咒就會從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you can touch a nonmagical object, or a section of a larger nonmagical object, that fits in a 5-foot cube. The target is reduced to dust. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你可以觸碰一個非魔法物件，或5尺立方空間可容納的更大體型非魔法物件其中的一部分。該目標化為粉塵。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: This charm has 9 charges. You can use an action to expend 1 charge from the charm to gain 30 temporary hit points. For the next hour, your eyes become voids of utter darkness, and you can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. Once all its charges have been expended, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 這個護咒有九發充能。你可以使用一個動作從護咒中消耗一發充能來獲得 30 點臨時生命值。在接下來的一個小時裡，你的眼睛變成了完全黑暗的空洞，你不能被{@condition charmed||魅惑}或{@condition frightened||恐慌}。一旦所有充能都用完了，這個護符就會從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you can force a creature you can see within 60 feet of you to focus on you. For 1 minute, creatures other than you and the target are {@condition invisible} to the target. The effect ends if any creature other than you damages the target or forces the target to make a saving throw. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 以一個動作，你可以強迫一個60尺內你可見的一個生物將注意力集中在你身上。1分鐘之內，除你之外的所有生物以及目標本身均對目標來說{@condition invisible||隱形}。如果除你以外的任何生物對目標造成傷害或強迫其進行豁免，則該效應結束。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an unarmed strike, you can infuse your strike with life-stealing energy. Your attack then deals an extra {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage, and you gain 5 {@book temporary hit points|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points}. Once used five times, the charm vanishes.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 每回合一次，當你用武器或徒手打擊發動的攻擊檢定，命中一個生物時，你可以為你本次打擊附加上生命竊取的力量。本次攻擊將額外造成{@damage 1d10}點暗蝕傷害，且你將獲得5點{@book 臨時生命值|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points}。此護咒可以使用5次，次數用盡後它將消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You can cast {@spell Otiluke's Resilient Sphere}, requiring no spell components and using your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice). Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你可以施放{@spell Otiluke's Resilient Sphere||歐提路克彈力法球}，無需法術成分且使用你的智力、感知或魅力作為施法屬性（由你選擇）。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You can cast {@spell Clairvoyance} as an action, without using a spell slot and requiring no material components. Once used three times, the charm vanishes.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 以一個動作，你可以施展法術{@spell Clairvoyance||鷹眼術}，無需法術位與材料成分。此護咒可以使用3次，次數用盡後它將消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You can tug on the threads of fate to tweak circumstance in your favor. After you make an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, you can roll a {@dice d10} and add it to the total, potentially turning failure into success. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你可以牽引命運的絲線以調整情況對你有利。在你進行了一次屬性檢定、攻擊檢定或豁免檢定之後，你可以擲一顆{@dice d10}並將其加到結果中，這可能會將失敗的檢定轉為成功。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you can summon two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils}. The summoned devils appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you, obey your commands, and can't summon other devils. The devils take their turns immediately after yours on the initiative count. A summoned devil remains for 10 minutes, until it or you die, or until you dismiss one or both summoned devils as an action. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你可以召喚兩隻{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}。被召喚的須魔出現在你60尺內的一處未佔據的地方並服從你的命令，且不能再召喚其他魔鬼。須魔在你的先攻順序後立即執行其回合。被召喚的須魔持續存在10分鐘，直到其或你死亡，或是你用動作解散一或兩個被召喚的須魔。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You can cast {@spell Major Image}, requiring no spell components and using your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice). When you cast the spell in this way, it lasts its full duration with no concentration required. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你可以施放{@spell Major Image||高等幻影}，無需法術成分且使用你的智力、感知或魅力作為施法屬性（由你選擇）。當你以此法施放該法術時，它持續其完整持續時間而無需維持專注。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you create a spray of {@dice 4d10} gems in a 30-foot cone originating from you. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of bludgeoning damage equal to the number of gems created. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. The gems remain after the effect ends, and each one is worth 10 gp. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你在一個以你為源點30尺的錐狀空間內創造{@dice 4d10}個寶石的噴濺水花。每個處於該區域內的生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}的敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗的生物受到等同於所創造寶石數量的鈍擊傷害。豁免成功則傷害減半。這些寶石在該效應結束後繼續存在，且每一個都價值10gp。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: This charm allows you to use an action to eat a mouthful of flesh from a humanoid that has been dead no longer than 1 day. When you do, you regain {@dice 3d8 + 3} hit points. Once used three times, the charm goes away.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 該護咒允許你用一個動作來吃下一口剛剛死亡不超過 1 天的類人生物的肉。當你這樣做時，你恢復 {@dice 3d8 + 3} 點生命值。該護咒使用 3 次後消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: You can cast {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter}, requiring no spell components and using your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice). Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 你可以施放{@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter||塔莎狂笑術}，無需法術成分且使用你的智力、感知或魅力作為施法屬性（由你選擇）。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a bonus action, you can touch a nonmagical melee weapon and imbue it with magic for 1 hour. For the duration, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} force damage on a hit and deals double damage to objects and structures. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為附贈動作，你可以接觸一個非魔法的近戰武器並讓其充滿魔力持續1小時。持續時間內，該武器命中時額外造成{@damage 1d8}力場傷害且對物件和建築造成雙倍傷害。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you can summon two neutral good {@creature Knight||knights} that are Celestials instead of Humanoids. The knights appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you and act as your allies. They take their turns immediately after yours on your initiative count. The knights remain for 10 minutes, until they or you die, or until you dismiss one or both of them as an action. Once used three times, the charm vanishes from you.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你可以召喚兩位中立善良的{@creature Knight||騎士}，其為天界生物而非類人生物。這些騎士出現在你60尺內的一處未佔據的地方並像你的盟友一般行動。其在你的先攻順序後立即執行其回合。這些騎士持續存在10分鐘，直到其或你死亡，或是你用動作解散一或兩位騎士。當使用了3次之後，該護咒從你身上消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: This charm allows you to regrow a lost appendage or organ, such as an arm, a foot, or an eye. After it is used once, the charm goes away.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 該護咒可以讓你的一處殘缺肢體或器官重新長出來，比如一條胳膊、一隻腳或一隻眼睛。該護咒使用 1 次後消失。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you make a minor wish. When you do, you create the effects of a spell of 5th level or lower. The spell takes effect as part of this action and requires no spell components. Your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability for this spell (your choice). tagShapeDifferencesResolved.translated: 當你在{@book 據點|XDMG|7}內完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}後，你獲得一個魔法 護咒（見{@book 第三章|XDMG|2}中" {@book 超自然贈禮|XDMG|2|超自然贈禮}"一節），該護咒持續7天或持續至你將其使用為止。該護咒允許你施展一次{@spell 醫療術|XPHB}，無需消耗法術位。你無法在已擁有該護咒時再次獲得它。
